data.narrative:
Raphe mPhibr is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Vivek and Vikash Mishra that has raised $145M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar stages, including peers such as Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a value proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yields $276M. Peer-median analysis across seven same-sector, same-stage comparables produced a $1.0B implied valuation, with the peer set ranging from $300M to $3.0B. The methodological divergence reflects dispersion in the defense-tech market, where valuations at this stage span an order of magnitude.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $234M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $638M. The wide band reflects genuine uncertainty around market positioning, customer traction, and IP defensibility—factors not captured in raised capital or peer multiples alone. Stage-progression serves as a floor given capital invested; peer medians anchor the midpoint; dispersion at the high end reflects outlier defense-tech valuations. Key uncertainties include revenue run-rate, contract pipeline, and whether the company tracks closer to the $300M–$600M or $1B+ peer clusters.
